title: Linked zero-inflation
text: ZINBL distribution defined mixture negative binomial distribution bernoulli process mixing proportion, π\pi modelled decreasing logistic function modskurt mean abundance, μ\mu, yn∼ZINBL[μn=Modskurt(xn),κ,πn]=πn⋅(yn==0)+(1−πn)⋅NB(μn,ϕ)logit−1πn=γ0−γ1⋅μn \begin{aligned} y_n &\sim \text{ZINBL}\left[\mu_n = \text{Modskurt}(x_n), \kappa, \pi_n\right] \\ &= \pi_n \cdot (y_n == 0) + (1 - \pi_n) \cdot \text{NB}(\mu_n, \phi) \\ \text{logit}^{-1}~\pi_n &= \gamma_0 - \gamma_1 \cdot \mu_n \end{aligned} new parameters: γ0∈ℝ\gamma_0 \\mathbb{R}: log-odds intercept probability observing excess-zero, γ1>0\gamma_1 > 0: describes rate excess-zero probability decreases average abundance increases. γ0→0\gamma_0 \0 γ1→∞\gamma_1 \\infty, π→0\pi \0 ZINBL reduces NB distribution. Muck around parameters . negative binomial model, modskurt package suggests default priors just work 🤞🤞: κ∼Exponential(0.5)γ0∼Normal(3.0,1.5)γ1∼HalfNormal(5.0) \begin{align} \kappa &\sim \text{Exponential}(0.5) \\ \gamma_0 &\sim \text{Normal}(3.0, 1.5) \\ \gamma_1 &\sim \text{HalfNormal}(5.0) \end{align} Note, now sampling effort, can internally standardise counts catch per unit effort (CPUE), y/area_swepty / \text{area_swept}, model using yn∼ZINBL[area_swept⋅μn,κ,πn] y_n \sim \text{ZINBL}\left[\text{area_swept} \cdot \mu_n, \kappa, \pi_n\right] Specifying model R: quick look model spec full dataset shows zero proportion 2252/2330=0.972252 / 2330 = 0.97:
